name: io.github.Former-Stranger/addy-mcp
title: addy.io
description: Manage addy.io email aliases, recipients, domains, rules and blocklist.

environmentVariables.name: ADDY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your addy.io API key (create one at https://app.addy.io/settings/api). Alternatively set ADDY_API_KEY_FILE.

environmentVariables.name: ADDY_API_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file containing the API key; takes precedence over ADDY_API_KEY

environmentVariables.name: ADDY_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to hide every tool that can change your account

environmentVariables.name: ADDY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for a self-hosted addy.io instance
